mapper.select: SELECT id, email, password_hash AS passwordHash, name, provider, status, created_at AS createdAt, deleted_at AS deletedAt FROM users WHERE email = #{email}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, name, provider, status, created_at) VALUES (#{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{name}, #{provider}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM terms WHERE required = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO terms_consent (user_id, terms_id, agreed, terms_version, agreed_at) SELECT #{userId}, id, #{agreed}, version, NOW() FROM terms WHERE id = #{termsId}
